name: Scarlet Base Camp
summary: Scarlet forces hold a barricaded camp on Lake Mereldar’s eastern shore, just west of Tyr’s Hand. It marks an outer line of the Scarlet Crusade.

sections.title: A Forward Line on Lake Mereldar
sections.body: On Lake Mereldar’s eastern shore, just west of Tyr’s Hand, the Scarlet Crusade holds a barricaded camp. It guards an outer line in the blighted countryside.

sections.title: Shielding the Bastion
sections.body: Tyr’s Hand is one of the Scarlet Crusade’s strongholds in Lordaeron. Scarlet Base Camp guards its western approaches as the Crusade seeks to reclaim land from the undead. Outsiders are met with suspicion.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Scarlet Base Camp?
faq.answer: Scarlet Base Camp is a barricaded Scarlet Crusade position on Lake Mereldar’s eastern shore, just west of Tyr’s Hand.

faq.q: Who leads the forces stationed at the camp?
faq.answer: No commander is identified for the original Classic camp. The Scarlet Crusade holds the position near Tyr’s Hand.

faq.q: Are the occupants hostile to travelers?
aliases: will scarlet base camp attack me
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade treats outsiders of both factions as possible plague carriers or agents of the Scourge, and is hostile to them.

faq.q: Where is the camp in relation to Lake Mereldar?
faq.answer: Scarlet Base Camp lies on Lake Mereldar’s eastern shore, just west of Tyr’s Hand.

angles.text: As a paladin, you see the Silver Hand’s legacy corrupted. Zeal to defend Lordaeron’s holy ground has turned into aggressive suspicion of fellow survivors.
As an undead traveler, you face living zealots who seek to purge the Forsaken from Lordaeron as ruthlessly as they hunt the mindless Scourge.
